name: Queantic Analytics
author: Queantic

sections.description:
Queantic Analytics is a powerful visitor tracking platform that helps you understand your website traffic. Track individual pages and posts with custom tracking codes, and view comprehensive analytics in your Queantic dashboard.

Features

  • Track individual pages and posts
  • Special pages tracking (homepage, blog, 404, search, archives)
  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Real-time tracking code validation
  • Tabbed interface for better organization
  • Pagination support for large sites
sections.installation:
1. Locate the “Tracking Code” in your Queantic dashboard and copy the full code provided by Queantic.
  2. Paste the codes in the rows corresponding to the pages/posts you want to track. (Each page/post requires its own unique tracking code)
  3. Click “Save Changes” after pasting your code.
  4. Thats it! View live analytics in your Queantic Dashboard after visitors land on your pages.
sections.faq:
How do I get tracking codes?

Visit your Queantic dashboard at https://queantic.com/dashboard to generate tracking codes for your pages.

Can I track special pages like 404 or search results?

Yes! The plugin supports tracking of special pages including homepage, blog page, 404 page, search results, and post archives.
